title: Database and EF Core foundation: Liquibase, partitioning, tenant context, audit log
objective: Establish the database conventions every later table follows: bigint identity PKs, tenant_id LIST partitioning with a partition-creation helper, EF Core DbContext with ambient tenant context and global query filters, and the audit_log with an audit writer (spec §11, §13, §15).
scope: Liquibase conventions: snake_case, changelog-per-feature includes, SQL-file changesets for functions with runOnChange
Partition helper function create_tenant_partitions(bigint) maintained via Liquibase
EF Core DbContext, ITenantContext, ITenantScoped convention, global query filter, tenant stamping interceptor
Testcontainers integration-test base fixture applying Liquibase to a fresh PostgreSQL
implementation_details: Application/Abstractions/ITenantContext.cs: { long? TenantId; bool IsCrossTenant; }; Infrastructure/Tenancy/TenantContext.cs scoped implementation set by middleware (T-006)

Infrastructure/Persistence/QuoteIqDbContext.cs: OnModelCreating applies snake_case naming, UseIdentityAlwaysColumn for bigint keys, and a model-level convention adding HasQueryFilter(e => e.TenantId == _tenantContext.TenantId) for every ITenantScoped entity; SaveChanges guard throws if an ITenantScoped entity is added without matching tenant context (unless IsCrossTenant)
Infrastructure/Persistence/AuditSaveChangesInterceptor.cs stamps created_/updated_ columns from ICurrentUser (placeholder until T-005)

db/changelog/010-foundation/: audit_log table (id bigint identity PK, tenant_id bigint null, entity_type text, entity_id text, action text, actor_user_id bigint null, acted_at timestamptz, details jsonb) + indexes (tenant_id, entity_type+entity_id, acted_at)

db/changelog/functions/create_tenant_partitions.sql (runOnChange:true): iterates a static list of partitioned table names (extended by later changesets) executing CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {t}_p{tenant_id} PARTITION OF {t} FOR VALUES IN ({tenant_id}); every partitioned parent also gets a {t}_default DEFAULT partition

Application/Abstractions/IAuditWriter.cs: Task WriteAsync(AuditEntry entry, CancellationToken ct); Infrastructure/Auditing/AuditWriter.cs appends via DbContext; AuditEntry record (EntityType, EntityId, Action, Details object serialized with System.Text.Json)

tests/QuoteIQ.Infrastructure.Tests/Fixtures/PostgresFixture.cs: Testcontainers postgres + Liquibase apply (invoke liquibase via docker or Liquibase CLI wrapper) shared by all integration tests (xUnit collection fixture)

findings.summary: V-076's structural schema-conventions test is missing, and T-003 is the sole owner of V-076
findings.detail: V-076 requires a schema-inspection test (information_schema/pg_partitioned_table) asserting PKs are bigint (no uuid key columns) and tenant-scoped tables are LIST-partitioned on tenant_id with composite PKs, with an explicit negative guarantee: a new tenant-scoped table lacking partitioning fails the conventions test. task_ids for V-076 is [T-003] only, so no later task will build it. Existing CreateTenantPartitionsTests plus test-only sample tables prove the helper function and demonstrate the convention, but nothing structurally enforces it for future tables. Fix: add a conventions integration test (e.g., PartitioningConventionsTests) that enumerates the EF model's ITenantScoped entity types (and/or all DB tables with a NOT NULL tenant_id column) and asserts each is LIST-partitioned on tenant_id with composite PK (tenant_id, id) and identity bigint id, and separately asserts no uuid-typed PK columns exist anywhere in the schema, running against the existing PostgresFixture so future business tables (T-007+) are automatically checked.
